Package neqsim.process.engineering.model

Class EngineeringDiagramStreamTable

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.model.EngineeringDiagramStreamTable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EngineeringDiagramStreamTable extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, deterministic stream-table projection of one governed operating case.

The table is derived only from the canonical semantic-object snapshots in an EngineeringDiagramDocumentSet. It does not read live process objects, change the controlled document JSON, or imply accountable approval of calculated values. A reviewed stream number is preferred for display while the canonical semantic-object identity remains authoritative.
